title: 第1章 巡山吏
novel_title: 长生修仙，从装备土龙鳞开始
content_zh:
【检测到方圆百里之内有可装备的灵物】

    【二阶下品灵物，『青萍炁』】

    【地点：岑山陈氏族库】

    【作用：装备后一次消耗，可临时获得九品水道仙基『青萍水』三十日】

    林玄看着眼前那层只有他能看见的青色光幕，心中忍不住暗叹一声。

    “两年了，还是没有新的灵物出现吗？”

    “按照契书，三年后若是突破不到炼气四层，就要被强行指派一名陈氏女子成婚。”

    “失去元阳后，修炼速度再减一成，筑基概率减少半成......”

    “前世看小说，总觉修仙并非难事，如今乃知难如登天。”

    “长生......长生。”

    是的，林玄并非此界之人。

    前世的他只是蓝星上一名普通的大学生。

    那日上课无聊，打了个盹，再醒来时，就已换了天地，占据了这具同名青年的身躯。

    而原身身份也很普通。

    出身凡俗，十岁时觉醒灵根，踏入修行之路。

    只是资质平平，加上又困于凡俗灵气稀薄之地，以至于苦修十年，也才堪堪达到炼气二层。

    恰逢此地仙门青云宗开门收徒，便与三名相熟同道结伴而行，跋涉万里，想要拜入仙门。

    原以为凭自身修为，多少有些机会。

    却不想，即便原身测出的灵根乃是四灵根资质，仍然得了一句“年岁过大，不予收录”的评语。

    更让他难以接受的是，同去之人中，竟然有一人被测出三灵根，虽然只有炼气一层，但仍被当场录入宗门。

    昔日不如自己之人，乘龙登天，而他自己却如草鸡一般，咕咕落地。

    此中落差，不足为外人所道也。

    不过，虽未被宗门收录，但并不意味着修行之路断绝。

    青云宗治下，有不少筑基世家，也趁机广纳落选的散修入赘。

    其中，岑山陈氏声名最盛。

    陈氏乃是宋国南境有名的筑基世家之一，传承绵延近千年，在岑山一地可谓根深叶茂。

    传闻族内有八位筑基老祖，其中不乏筑基后期的强者。

    单凭这份实力，便足以压得周边修仙家族与散修势力不敢轻举妄动。

    更难得的是，陈氏对入赘散修的态度颇为宽厚，入赘后不但能得到一份稳定差事，还可享受部分修炼资源。

    虽说身份终究比不得陈氏嫡系族人，却也远胜寻常散修。

    于是剩下三人商议一番后，便跋山涉水来到岑山坊市。

    签订契书之后，其余两人很快与陈氏族人成婚，各自安顿下来。

    唯有原身仍对长生大道心存执念，不愿如此舍弃元阳，因此迟迟没有与陈氏族人婚配。

    对此，陈氏倒也并未强逼，只是派人提醒过原身几次。

    若是不婚配，族中任务所得的报酬，自然比不得那些已经成婚、为陈氏延续血脉之人。

    而且按照契书约定，若他在二十七岁之前仍未能突破至炼气四层，届时便不得再推拒，必须由陈氏指派一名族中女子，与其成婚。

    而被强行指派的陈氏女子，相貌和性情自然都远不如自行挑选来得合心意。

    也正因如此，大多数入赘散修宁愿早早成婚，也不愿拖到最后，被族中随意指派一人。

    原身已二十二岁，修为却仍停留在炼气二层，距离最后期限看似还有数年。

    可对于修士而言，想在短短五年内连破两层，踏入炼气中期，几乎难如登天。

    也正因如此，原身在接下来的时间里修炼得愈发急切，心中压力日重，很快便在一次闭关修行时，不慎走火入魔，神与魂俱灭。

    也正是在这一刻，来自蓝星的林玄穿越而来，取而代之。

    而随林玄一同而来的，还有一个装备栏系统，其功能可以说非常的简单。

    当这系统判定某种灵物的所有权归林玄之后，便可将这灵物装备在“栏位”之中，为自身所用。

    装备后获得的效果可谓是五花八门，十分强力，但却有一点限制。

    不是所有的灵物都可以装备。

    必须先经过系统的“检测”后，显示为“灵物可装备”后才能装进装备栏里。

    只有“可装备”的灵物，才会显示在林玄眼前的这道光幕上。

    而那些“不可装备的灵物”，哪怕摆在林玄眼前，也无法放入装备栏。

    可能是这系统也知道这样的限制实在太过离谱，因此也是非常贴心地给林玄装备了一个检测面板。

    每日子时刷新一次，可检测自身方圆百里之内是否有可装备的灵物。

    不然光靠林玄一件一件地找，估计一辈子也找不到几个能装备的。

    林玄还算幸运，刚穿越过来，第一次检测就发现了两个可装备的灵物。

    第一个是一块一阶中品灵药，黄精。

    林玄花光了全部身家，才在族内的一个小型交易会上，从一个老者手中买下。

    有些肉疼，但一切都是值得的。

    装备灵草后，林玄的修为直接从炼气二层的中段，一举突破到了炼气三层，至少为他省去三年的时间。

    至于第二件灵物，则是方才光幕中出现的『青萍炁』。

    装备后的效果是临时获得三十日的水道筑基修士的修为，效果之强，馋得林玄直流口水。

    只是以他如今的修为和财力，想要换取这『青萍炁』无疑是痴人说梦。

    因此如今之计也只能是一边努力修炼、积攒灵石，一边等待新的可装备灵物出现。

    正当林玄还沉浸在回忆中的时候，耳畔，一道粗犷的声音突然响起。

    “喂，林小子，我说的你到底听清了没？”

    “这第一次巡山，是我带你走一遍，接下来可就是你一个人巡山了。”

    “别灵禁损坏了还不知道上报，到时候要是被扣灵石，可别怪我没教过你啊。”

    林玄心念一动，下一刻光幕消散，视线也重回到了现实。

    眼前是一片茂密的丛林，林玄环视四周，目光落在了一名正蹲在灵禁前仔细检查的中年汉子身上。

    “知道了，百林哥。”

    这汉子名叫张百林，正是当年与林玄一同来到岑山陈氏的两名散修之一。

    相比原身先前那份耕种灵田的差事，巡山虽苦，却胜在报酬丰厚。

    若是运气好，还能在山中寻到些灵草、矿材之类的额外收获，不知强了多少。

    原身其实早就动过念头，想请张百林帮忙引荐一番，只是他脸皮薄，始终不好意思开这个口。

    穿越后的林玄可没有这些顾虑。

    修仙不易，机缘难求。

    既然有更好的差事摆在眼前，他自然不会为了那点矜持白白错过。

    两年后林玄得到消息，有一名巡山吏年老体衰，退了下来。

    于是便主动找到了张百林，请他帮忙引荐一二。

    就这样，林玄被推荐了上去，得了这份差事。

    确认最后一处灵禁完好无损后，张百林起身狠狠地伸了一个懒腰，从腰间摸出一只酒葫芦，狠狠地灌了一口。

    “爽，终于他娘的完事了。”
content_en:
[Detected that there are spiritual objects that can be equipped within a hundred miles]
[Second-order low-grade spiritual object, "Qing Ping Qi"]
[Location: Chen Clan Library in Censhan]
[Function: After equipping and consuming it once, you can temporarily obtain the ninth-grade Water Dao Immortal Base "Qingping Water" for thirty days]
Lin Xuan looked at the cyan light curtain in front of him that only he could see, and couldn't help but sigh in his heart.
"It's been two years and there's still no new spiritual creature appearing?"
"According to the contract, if you fail to break through to the fourth level of Qi Refining in three years, you will be forcibly assigned to a woman from the Chen family to get married."
"After losing Yuanyang, the cultivation speed will be reduced by another 10%, and the probability of foundation building will be reduced by half..."
"When I read novels in my previous life, I always felt that cultivating immortality was not difficult, but now I know it is as difficult as climbing to heaven."
"Eternal life...everlasting life."
Yes, Lin Xuan is not from this world.
In his previous life, he was just an ordinary college student on Blue Star.
I was bored in class that day, so I took a nap. When I woke up again, the world had changed, occupying the body of the young man with the same name.
And the original identity is also very ordinary.
Born in an ordinary world, he awakened his spiritual roots at the age of ten and embarked on the path of spiritual practice.
It's just that his qualifications are mediocre, and he is trapped in a place where ordinary spiritual energy is thin, so he has only been able to reach the second level of Qi refining after ten years of hard training.
It happened that the Qingyun Sect of the Immortal Sect here had opened its doors to accept disciples, so he traveled thousands of miles with three acquaintances and wanted to join the Immortal Sect.
I thought that based on my own cultivation, I would have some chances.
Unexpectedly, even though the spiritual roots measured by the original body were the qualifications of the Four Spiritual Roots, he still received the comment "too old and will not be included".
What made it even more difficult for him to accept was that one of the people who went with him was actually tested for three spiritual roots. Although he was only at the first level of Qi Refining, he was still admitted to the sect on the spot.
People who were inferior to him in the past rode a dragon to the sky, but he himself fell to the ground like a chicken.
The gap here is not enough for outsiders to understand.
However, although he is not included in the sect, it does not mean that the path of cultivation is cut off.
Under the Qingyun Sect, there were many foundation-building families who took the opportunity to recruit unselected casual cultivators into their families.
Among them, the Chen family in Censhan is the most famous.
The Chen family is one of the famous foundation-building families in the southern part of the Song Dynasty. The inheritance has lasted for nearly a thousand years, and it can be said that it has deep roots in Cen Mountain.
It is rumored that there are eight foundation-building ancestors in the clan, many of whom are strong in the later stages of foundation-building.
This strength alone is enough to suppress the surrounding cultivating families and casual cultivating forces from daring to act rashly.
What's even more rare is that the Chen family has a very generous attitude towards those who join the family as independent practitioners. After joining the family, not only can they get a stable job, but they can also enjoy part of the training resources.
Although his status is ultimately inferior to that of the direct lineage members of the Chen family, he is still far superior to ordinary casual cultivators.
So after some discussion, the remaining three people traveled across mountains and rivers to Censhanfang City.
After signing the deed, the remaining two people quickly married the Chen clan and settled down separately.
Only the original person is still obsessed with the road to immortality and is unwilling to abandon Yuanyang like this, so he has not married anyone from the Chen clan.
In this regard, Chen did not force him, but sent people to remind him several times.
If they are not married, the rewards from tasks within the clan will naturally be inferior to those who are already married and continue the bloodline of the Chen family.
Moreover, according to the contract, if he fails to break through to the fourth level of Qi Refining before the age of twenty-seven, then he will no longer be able to refuse, and the Chen family must appoint a woman from the clan to marry him.
Naturally, the appearance and temperament of the Chen women who were forcibly assigned were far less to their liking than choosing by themselves.
Because of this, most casual cultivators would rather get married early than wait until the end and be randomly assigned by the clan.
The original body is already twenty-two years old, but his cultivation is still at the second level of Qi Refining. It seems that there are still several years before the deadline.
But for a monk, it is almost as difficult as climbing to the sky to break through two levels in a row and enter the middle stage of Qi refining in just five years.
Because of this, the original person practiced more and more eagerly in the following time, and the pressure in his heart became increasingly heavy. Soon, during a retreat, he accidentally went into a demon, and his spirit and soul were destroyed.
It was at this moment that Lin Xuan from Blue Star came through and took his place.
Along with Lin Xuan, there is also an equipment slot system, whose function can be said to be very simple.
After the system determines that the ownership of a certain spiritual object belongs to Lin Xuan, it can equip the spiritual object in the "slot" for its own use.
The effects obtained after equipping it can be described as varied and very powerful, but there are some limitations.
Not all spiritual objects can be equipped.
It must first be "detected" by the system and displayed as "spiritual items can be equipped" before it can be loaded into the equipment slot.
Only "equipable" spiritual objects will be displayed on the light screen in front of Lin Xuan.
And those "unequipped spiritual objects" cannot be put into the equipment slot even if they are placed in front of Lin Xuan.
Maybe the system also knew that such restrictions were too outrageous, so it thoughtfully equipped Lin Xuan with a detection panel.
It is refreshed once a day and can detect whether there are equippable spiritual objects within a hundred miles of yourself.
Otherwise, just relying on Lin Xuan to look for them one by one, he would probably not be able to find a few that can be equipped in his lifetime.
Lin Xuan was lucky. He had just traveled through time and found two equippable spiritual objects during the first test.
The first one is a piece of first-order middle-grade elixir, Polygonatum japonica.
Lin Xuan spent all his wealth before buying it from an old man at a small trade fair within the clan.
It hurts a little, but it's all worth it.
After equipping the spiritual grass, Lin Xuan's cultivation level broke through directly from the middle of the second level of Qi Refining to the third level of Qi Refining, saving him at least three years.
As for the second spiritual object, it was the "Qing Ping Qi" that appeared in the light curtain just now.
The effect after equipping it is to temporarily gain the cultivation level of a water channel foundation-building monk for thirty days. The effect is so powerful that Lin Xuan drools.
But with his current cultivation and financial resources, it is undoubtedly a foolish dream to exchange for this "Qing Ping Qi".
Therefore, the only solution now is to practice hard and accumulate spiritual stones while waiting for new equipmentable spiritual objects to appear.
While Lin Xuan was still immersed in memories, a rough voice suddenly sounded in his ears.
"Hey, boy Lin, did you hear what I said clearly?"
"This is your first mountain patrol, I will take you there, and then you will patrol the mountain alone."
"Don't know how to report the damage to the spirit forbidden area. If the spirit stone is taken away by then, don't blame me for not teaching you."
Lin Xuan thought, and the next moment the light curtain dissipated, and his vision returned to reality.
There was a dense jungle in front of him. Lin Xuan looked around and his eyes fell on a middle-aged man who was squatting in front of the spiritual prison and inspecting it carefully.
"I know, Brother Bai Lin."
This man's name was Zhang Bailin, and he was one of the two casual cultivators who came to the Chen family in Censhan with Lin Xuan.
Compared with the original job of cultivating spiritual fields, mountain patrol is hard work, but it is more rewarding.
If you are lucky, you can also find some additional harvests such as spiritual herbs and mineral materials in the mountains. I don't know how much better it is.
In fact, the original person had already thought about asking Zhang Bailin to help introduce him, but he was thin-skinned and was always embarrassed to ask this question.
Lin Xuan didn't have these worries after traveling through time.
It is not easy to cultivate immortality, and opportunities are hard to come by.
Since there was a better job in front of him, he would not miss it for his modesty.
Two years later, Lin Xuan received news that a mountain ranger was old and frail and had retired.
So he took the initiative to find Zhang Bailin and asked him to help introduce him.
In this way, Lin Xuan was recommended and got the job.
After confirming that the last spiritual restraint was intact, Zhang Bailin stood up, stretched hard, took out a wine gourd from his waist, and took a sip.
"It's great, it's finally fucking done."
